sections.faq:
Is YS LeadGen free to use?

Yes! The free version includes all essential popup types, templates, targeting options, and analytics. Upgrade to PRO for advanced features like countdown timers and unlimited views.

Do I need coding skills?

Not at all! Our drag-and-drop popup builder makes it easy to create professional popups without any coding knowledge.

Will popups slow down my website?

No. YS LeadGen is optimized for performance and loads asynchronously without affecting your site speed.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! All popups are fully responsive and optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

Can I show different popups to different visitors?

Yes! Use our advanced targeting to show personalized popups based on visitor behavior, location, device, traffic source, and more.

How many popups can I create?

Unlimited! Create as many popup campaigns as you need. Pro users also get unlimited monthly views.

Can I schedule popups?

Yes! Campaign scheduling lets you set start and end dates for automated seasonal campaigns and limited-time offers.

How do I prevent popup fatigue?

Use our display frequency controls to limit how often visitors see your popups. Set rules like “show once per session” or “show every 7 days.”

Can I target popups by traffic source?

Yes! Show different popups to visitors from Google, Facebook, email campaigns, or any referral source using UTM parameters.

Do you offer exit intent popups?

Yes! Exit intent technology is included in the free version. It detects when visitors are about to leave and shows your popup at the perfect moment.

Can I collect leads without an email service?

Yes! All leads are stored in your WordPress dashboard. You can view, filter, and export them to CSV anytime.

Can I show popups on specific pages only?

Yes! Use our page targeting rules to show popups on specific pages, posts, categories, or anywhere on your site.

Can I display countdown timers in popups?

Yes! Countdown timer popups are available in the PRO version. Create urgency with real-time countdowns for sales and limited offers.

Create high-converting WordPress popups, exit intent forms, and lead capture campaigns to grow your email list and increase sales – no coding needed!

Create Beautiful WordPress Popups ThatActually Convert – Trusted by Smart Marketers

YS LeadGen is the best WordPress popup plugin that helps you capture more leads, reduce cart abandonment, and skyrocket your sales with professionally designed popup campaigns.

Create stunning popups, exit intent popups, coupon popups, and lead generation campaigns in minutes using our drag-and-drop popup builder – no coding or design skills required!

Whether you want to grow your email list, recover abandoned carts, or boost WooCommerce sales with targeted offers, YS LeadGen gives you everything you need to create popups that convert visitors into customers.

  • “We’ve tried several popup plugins, and YS LeadGen is by far the most intuitive. The templates saved us hours, and our email list is growing faster than ever. Highly recommend!” @Creative Assets

View Live Demo | Documentation | Get Support | Visit Website

Why Choose YS LeadGen WordPress Popup Plugin?

Unlike basic popup makers, YS LeadGen is built specifically for conversions with advanced targeting, behavior tracking, and proven popup templates that work.

What You Can Achieve:

  • Collect Email Addresses
    Build a segmented email list with relevant leads and quality subscribers.

  • Increase Product Sales
    Sell more to your website visitors without being annoying and drive more revenue.

  • Guide Your Visitors
    Create a personalized shopping experience for each visitor and send them to the products or pages they should see.

  • Connect with Visitors
    Invite visitors and customers to contact you for support, feedback, or sales calls when needed.

  • Multiple Popups for Multiple Goals
    From email capture to reducing cart abandonment, create multiple personalized popups for different groups of visitors.

Powerful WordPress Popup Types – Everything You Need to Convert Visitors

Create any type of popup campaign for every stage of your customer journey. No two visitors are alike – meet each visitor where they are in their journey. Target them with personalized popups based on how much they know you and how they behave on your site.

Smart Welcome Popups – Turn New Visitors into Subscribers

Greet first-time visitors at the perfect moment instead of showing popups immediately when they land on your website.
With smart triggers like time delay and scroll depth, you can display relevant offers right when visitors are most engaged.

Perfect for:

  • Capturing first-time visitor emails
  • Showing welcome discounts after scroll
  • Growing your subscriber list faster
  • Reducing early exits and improving engagement

Subscriber Conversion Popups – Help Subscribers Make Their First Purchase

Convert your email subscribers into paying customers with highly targeted promotions. Automatically trigger personalized offers when subscribers browse key pages or add products to their cart.

Perfect for:

  • Offering exclusive first-purchase coupons
  • Running targeted sales campaigns
  • Showing personalized product recommendations
  • Converting subscribers into new customers

Customer Loyalty Popups – Sell More to Your Existing Customers

Delight returning customers with personalized popups and exclusive deals. Use upsells, cross-sells, and logged-in user targeting to increase repeat purchases and maximize customer lifetime value.

Perfect for:

  • Showing exclusive offers for logged-in users
  • Upselling and cross-selling related products
  • Rewarding loyal customers with VIP deals
  • Boosting average order value and repeat sales

Exit Intent Popups – Stop Visitors from Leaving

Capture abandoning visitors at the exact moment they’re about to leave your site. Exit intent technology detects mouse movement and shows your best offer before they close the browser tab.

Perfect for:

  • Offering last-minute discounts (10% off, free shipping)
  • Capturing email addresses before exit
  • Reducing bounce rates and cart abandonment
  • Recovering lost sales instantly

Lead Capture Popups – Grow Your Email List Fast

Build your subscriber list with beautiful popup forms that collect emails, phone numbers, and other lead information.

Perfect for:

  • Newsletter signups with welcome discounts
  • Content upgrade offers (ebooks, guides, templates)
  • Webinar registrations and event signups
  • Building your marketing automation list

Coupon Popups – Boost Sales with Instant Discounts

Show irresistible discount codes and promotional offers that motivate visitors to buy now.

Perfect for:

  • First-purchase discounts for new visitors
  • Holiday and seasonal sale promotions
  • Flash sale announcements
  • Cart-level discounts and special offers

Cart Abandonment Popups – Recover Lost Revenue

Re-engage shoppers who add items to cart but don’t complete checkout. Show targeted reminders and incentives to recover abandoned carts.

Perfect for:

  • Offering checkout incentives (free shipping, discounts)
  • Reminding shoppers about items in their cart
  • Reducing WooCommerce cart abandonment rates
  • Increasing completed purchases

Entry Popups – Make a Great First Impression

Welcome new visitors with engaging popups that guide them toward your best offers or content.

Perfect for:

  • Welcome messages for first-time visitors
  • Special offers for new customers
  • Directing visitors to popular content
  • Building brand awareness

Light Popups – Non-Intrusive Overlays

Create subtle, elegant popups that capture attention without disrupting user experience.

Perfect for:

  • Gentle email signup reminders
  • Cookie consent notices
  • Quick announcements and updates
  • Mobile-friendly notifications

Show different popups based on where visitors come from:

  • Direct traffic vs search engines

  • UTM parameter tracking

Built-in Popup Analytics

Track performance and optimize conversions:

Lead Management Dashboard

Manage all your captured leads in one place:

  • View, filter, and search leads
  • Export leads to CSV
  • Lead source tracking
  • Integration with email marketing tools
